import os, json, base64

key_file = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')
with open(key_file) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5592ebe2880afa241'

# R script for the analysis
r_script = '''
set -eu

# Install readxl from CRAN (small package, fast install)
Rscript -e 'install.packages("readxl", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet=TRUE)'

# Run the analysis
Rscript - <<'RSCRIPT'
library(readxl)

# Read the data: skip title row, no column names
input_file <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[1]
data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = "RAW DATA", skip = 1, col_names = FALSE)

# Extract miRNA names (skip header row)
mirna_names <- as.character(unlist(data[-1, 1]))

# Patient: cols 2-11, Control: cols 12-21
patient_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[-1, 2:11], as.numeric))
control_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[-1, 12:21], as.numeric))

n_mirna <- length(mirna_names)
p_values <- numeric(n_mirna)
p_values[] <- NA

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  p_vals <- as.numeric(patient_data[i, ])
  c_vals <- as.numeric(control_data[i, ])
  p_vals <- p_vals[!is.na(p_vals)]
  c_vals <- c_vals[!is.na(c_vals)]
  
  if (length(p_vals) >= 2 && length(c_vals) >= 2 && sd(p_vals) + sd(c_vals) > 0) {
    tryCatch({
      test <- t.test(p_vals, c_vals)
      p_values[i] <- test$p.value
    }, error = function(e) {
      p_values[i] <- NA
    })
  } else {
    p_values[i] <- NA
  }
}

# Number of tests (non-NA p-values)
n_tests <- sum(!is.na(p_values))

# Bonferroni correction
p_bonf <- pmin(p_values * n_tests, 1)

# Benjamini-Yekutieli correction
p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")

# Count significant
n_bonf_sig <- sum(p_bonf <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_by_sig <- sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete\\n")
cat(sprintf("Total miRNAs tested: %d\\n", n_mirna))
cat(sprintf("MiRNAs with valid p-values: %d\\n", n_tests))
cat(sprintf("Significant with Bonferroni (p<=0.05): %d\\n", n_bonf_sig))
cat(sprintf("Significant with BY (p<=0.05): %d\\n", n_by_sig))

# Write detailed results
results <- data.frame(
  miRNA = mirna_names,
  p_value = round(p_values, 10),
  p_bonferroni = round(p_bonf, 10),
  p_by = round(p_by, 10),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.table(results, "results.tsv", sep = "\\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Write counts summary
writeLines(
  c(
    sprintf("miRNAs_tested\\t%d", n_mirna),
    sprintf("miRNAs_with_valid_pvalues\\t%d", n_tests),
    sprintf("significant_bonferroni\\t%d", n_bonf_sig),
    sprintf("significant_by\\t%d", n_by_sig),
    sprintf("ratio_bonferroni_by\\t%d:%d", n_bonf_sig, n_by_sig)
  ),
  "counts.tsv"
)

cat("\\nOutputs written: results.tsv, counts.tsv\\n")
RSCRIPT
'''

INPUT_TSV="$(inputs.input_tsv.path)"

cat > analysis.R << "ENDRSCRIPT"
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]

# Read the TSV: title row first, then header
lines <- readLines(input_file)
header <- strsplit(lines[2], "\\t")[[1]]
data_lines <- lines[3:length(lines)]

# Parse miRNA names and data
n_mirna <- length(data_lines)
mirna_names <- character(n_mirna)
patient_data <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_mirna, ncol=10)
control_data <- matrix(NA, nrow=n_mirna, ncol=10)

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  parts <- strsplit(data_lines[i], "\\t")[[1]]
  mirna_names[i] <- parts[1]
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[-1]))
  patient_data[i, ] <- vals[1:10]
  control_data[i, ] <- vals[11:20]
}

# Run t-tests
p_values <- numeric(n_mirna)
p_values[] <- NA

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  p_vals <- patient_data[i, ]
  c_vals <- control_data[i, ]
  p_vals <- p_vals[!is.na(p_vals)]
  c_vals <- c_vals[!is.na(c_vals)]
  
  if (length(p_vals) >= 2 && length(c_vals) >= 2) {
    pv <- tryCatch({
      if (sd(p_vals) > 0 || sd(c_vals) > 0) {
        t.test(p_vals, c_vals)$p.value
      } else {
        NA
      }
    }, error = function(e) NA)
    p_values[i] <- pv
  }
}

# Multiple testing corrections
n_tests <- sum(!is.na(p_values))
p_bonf <- pmin(p_values * n_tests, 1)
p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")

# Count significant
n_bonf_sig <- sum(p_bonf <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_by_sig <- sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete\\n")
cat(sprintf("Total miRNAs tested: %d\\n", n_mirna))
cat(sprintf("MiRNAs with valid p-values: %d\\n", n_tests))
cat(sprintf("Significant with Bonferroni (p<=0.05): %d\\n", n_bonf_sig))
cat(sprintf("Significant with BY (p<=0.05): %d\\n", n_by_sig))

# Write detailed results
results <- data.frame(
  miRNA = mirna_names,
  p_value = round(p_values, 10),
  p_bonferroni = round(p_bonf, 10),
  p_by = round(p_by, 10),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

  c(

    sprintf("miRNAs_with_valid_pvalues\\t%d", n_tests),
    sprintf("significant_bonferroni\\t%d", n_bonf_sig),
    sprintf("significant_by\\t%d", n_by_sig),
    sprintf("ratio_bonferroni_by\\t%d:%d", n_bonf_sig, n_by_sig)
  ),
  "counts.tsv"
)

Rscript -e "install.packages('readxl', repos='https://cloud.r-project.org', lib='$R_LIBS_DIR', quiet=TRUE)"

# Write R analysis script
cat > analysis.R << "ENDRSCRIPT"
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
rlibs_dir <- args[1]
input_file <- args[2]

.libPaths(c(rlibs_dir, .libPaths()))
library(readxl)

data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = "RAW DATA", skip = 1, col_names = FALSE)

mirna_names <- as.character(unlist(data[-1, 1]))
patient_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[-1, 2:11], as.numeric))
control_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[-1, 12:21], as.numeric))

n_mirna <- length(mirna_names)
p_values <- numeric(n_mirna)
p_values[] <- NA

for (i in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
  p_vals <- as.numeric(patient_data[i, ])
  c_vals <- as.numeric(control_data[i, ])
  p_vals <- p_vals[!is.na(p_vals)]
  c_vals <- c_vals[!is.na(c_vals)]
  if (length(p_vals) >= 2 && length(c_vals) >= 2) {
    if (sd(p_vals) > 0 || sd(c_vals) > 0) {
      tryCatch({
        test <- t.test(p_vals, c_vals)
        p_values[i] <- test$p.value
      }, error = function(e) { p_values[i] <- NA })
    }
  }
}

n_tests <- sum(!is.na(p_values))
p_bonf <- pmin(p_values * n_tests, 1)
p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")
n_bonf_sig <- sum(p_bonf <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_by_sig <- sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete", "\n", sep="")
cat(sprintf("Total miRNAs tested: %d\n", n_mirna))
cat(sprintf("MiRNAs with valid p-values: %d\n", n_tests))
cat(sprintf("Significant with Bonferroni: %d\n", n_bonf_sig))
cat(sprintf("Significant with BY: %d\n", n_by_sig))

results <- data.frame(
  miRNA = mirna_names,
  p_value = round(p_values, 10),
  p_bonferroni = round(p_bonf, 10),
  p_by = round(p_by, 10),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(results, "results.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

writeLines(
  c(
    sprintf("miRNAs_tested\t%d", n_mirna),
    sprintf("miRNAs_with_valid_pvalues\t%d", n_tests),
    sprintf("significant_bonferroni\t%d", n_bonf_sig),
    sprintf("significant_by\t%d", n_by_sig),
    sprintf("ratio_bonferroni_by\t%d:%d", n_bonf_sig, n_by_sig)
  ),
  "counts.tsv"
)
ENDRSCRIPT

# Run analysis
Rscript analysis.R "$R_LIBS_DIR" "$INPUT_XLS"
